content: Mage Wars  Lead Character Iceni, Originally a Staff Sergeant and Ranger has fallen to earth, She is alone and scared but meets a mage, Artinimus, we fast forward to find them living in the south, Mages are hated and feared , mostly left alone they live in two casts, those of the land and healing and those of the blade and warriors. Iceni has Marries Artinimus and now has two daughters, lives her days practicing magic and growing the fields with her husband. The mages who live by combat stay to the north, Artinimus has made a pact, allowing them to live in peace as long as they pay a tithe allowing the two groups to live in peace. Artinimus also has a deal with the lands to the west, ruled by a warlord king who covets the rich lands.  After eight years of peace Artinimus dies, leaving his throne to his wife. The king to the west takes this opportunity to invade, beating Iceni and killing her to daughters. He stations troops , taking the lands and forcing the mages into subjugation, he takes their children to experiment or be slaves, Iceni escapes barely alive to the North and is found by a small tribe of the warlike mage warriors, she is taken to their king, Iceni is made a slave and but she is a fallen, her powers are vast and she is a ranger and soon begins to learn the ways of the war tribes and there magic.  Once she has mastered combat magic, she challenges the king for control of the tribe, a slave has never done this but the king thinking the woman weak laughs and agrees, she beats the king and two of his closest and best warriors and takes the throne.  What begins is a bloody massacre as she consolidates power and sets the tribes to war. Marching to the south they free the mages under the king’s control, showing no mercy to the troops. She will not stop until the king is dead and mobilizes the farmers, teaching the mages a new way to fight, forging magical weapons she trains them like rangers, adapting the teachings for magic.  Iseni brings guerilla warfare to the king and his massive army, winning battle after battle she soon sees the results of her war as they find other tribes of mages who are slaughtered in response to her uprising. She presses the field, taking more from the king. Finally, the church with their knowledge of earlier fights with the mages brings their weapons to bear and join the battle.  They battle and many, many die until finally Iseni, tired of the stalemate and the death of her people makes a treaty, The King has died, leaving his son on the throne, he is far more reasonable then his father having seen first-hand what war does to the lands., They bring the mage lands into the kingdom and the mages are now full subjects, however they will need be marked to ensure they are known. Iseni creates the order of the dragon and the agreement is signed.
